description: Find brands where a single operator controls 100 percent of observed buybox days. These are either gated/exclusive or operator-acquired brands. Use when the user asks 'brands with one seller', 'exclusive brands', 'single-seller brands', 'monopoly brands', or any question about brands with no competition.

category_id.description: Filter to a specific root category. Omit for all.

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

max_avg_price.description: Maximum average price in USD. Omit for no cap.

min_asins.description: Minimum ASINs to filter out trivially small brands (default 10).

min_avg_price.description: Minimum average price in USD. Omit for no floor.

min_buybox_days.description: Minimum observed buybox days in last 3 months (default 30).

name: find_single_seller_brands
